summary: ptrace_hosttest.c with eleven faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/proc/ptrace.c and debugreg_hosttest.c with 28 in rach2/sys/arch/x86/debugreg.c; the test runs both

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -ffreestanding -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc -o ${WORK}/ptrace_hosttest tests/host/ptrace_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c && exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -DRACH2_HOST_CPU -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -ffreestanding -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc -o ${WORK}/debugreg_hosttest tests/host/debugreg_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c
s=0; for t in ptrace_hosttest debugreg_hosttest; do ${WORK}/$t || { r=$?; [ $s -ne 0 ] || s=$r; }; done; exit $s

faults.name: regset
faults.summary: a regset call does not look the tracee up again after its copy sleeps

lines: regset revalidates after sleeping copy

faults.name: listen
faults.summary: an interrupt does not stop a listening tracee again

lines: interrupt releases listening tracee

faults.name: return-stops
faults.summary: the return to user mode takes one stop, not every one pending

lines: listening interrupts stop before user return

faults.name: return-kill

lines: kill ends return stop sequence

faults.name: options

lines: setoptions refuses upper bits

faults.name: seize
faults.summary: PTRACE_SEIZE reads its options as 32 bits

edits.find: static int ptrace_attach(process_t *t, int seize, unsigned long opts)
edits.replace: static int ptrace_attach(process_t *t, int seize, uint32_t opts)

lines: seize refuses upper bits without attaching
